name: @poker-club/mobile
//qrcode: Pinned EXACTLY, not caret-ranged: src/lib/qr.ts imports qrcode/lib/core/qrcode.js, which is internal to the package and not covered by its semver promise. The renderers behind the main entry need canvas or fs and cannot run here.
//expo-updates: Nothing imports it. It is here because `eas update` refuses to publish without it, and publishing is how the app reaches an iPhone with no paid Apple Developer account behind it — see docs/live-test.md. In Expo Go the native side is Expo Go's own, so the package is inert at runtime. ~57.0.21 is SDK 57's version from bundledNativeModules.json, which is exactly what `expo install` would have chosen.
//sdk: Expo SDK 57, pinned to match the Expo Go build in the App Store. Every version below comes from SDK 57's own bundledNativeModules manifest — do not bump one on its own. SDK 57 unified the expo-* packages onto the SDK's own version number, which is why they all read ~57.x rather than a version apiece.

scripts.//publish:go: Put the app where a phone can open it in Expo Go with NO dev server and NO laptop — the update is fetched from Expo over any connection. EAS_PROJECT=go is the load-bearing part: it leaves runtimeVersion off, and an update carrying one is refused by Expo Go. Needs `npx eas-cli login` as the account that owns the project, and the phone's Expo Go signed into the same account. docs/live-test.md is the whole procedure.
scripts.publish:go: EAS_PROJECT=go npx eas-cli@latest update --branch expo-go --message "$(git log -1 --pretty=%s)"
scripts.//export:web: A static build of the real app, for scripts/ui-check.mjs to drive in a headless browser. Same components, same tokens, at the frames' 402x874.
